procedure_column: Chernonozhkin et al. 2021 (Chem Geol 562) Pallasite olivine Line scan (Run 1: major) + Spot (Run 2: trace) [Multi-run] ns-LA-SF-ICP-MS Ghent University

Procedure Name.cell: Chernonozhkin et al. (2021) Pallasite Olivine Multi-run Spot/Transect v1
Procedure Name.value: Chernonozhkin et al. (2021) Pallasite Olivine Multi-run Spot/Transect v1

Procedure Author.cell: Chernonozhkin, Pittarello, Goderis, Vanhaecke et al.
Procedure Author.value: Chernonozhkin, Pittarello, Goderis, Vanhaecke et al.

Laboratory.cell: Dept. of Chemistry, Atomic & Mass Spectrometry, Ghent University, Belgium
Laboratory.value: Dept. of Chemistry, Atomic & Mass Spectrometry, Ghent University, Belgium

Funding Source for Procedure Development.cell: Planet Topers (BELSPO); FWO; Alexander von Humboldt Foundation; FWO/BOF-UGent
Funding Source for Procedure Development.value: Planet Topers (BELSPO); FWO; Alexander von Humboldt Foundation; FWO/BOF-UGent

Procedure Reference(s).cell: Chernonozhkin et al. (2021) Chem. Geol. 562; Liu et al. (2008) for IS method
Procedure Reference(s).value: Chernonozhkin et al. (2021) Chem. Geol. 562; Liu et al. (2008) for IS method

Sampling Unit Type.cell: Grain (individual olivine crystal) > Region of interest (line scan) — "a second line-scan was completed on top of the first one, using a laser spot of 130 μm diameter ... and a translation speed of 10 μm s−1" (p.3)
Sampling Unit Type.value: Grain (individual olivine crystal) > Region of interest (line scan)

Sample Preparation Method.cell: PMG thick sections polished; pre-ablation pass (2 J cm⁻², 20 Hz, 150 µm square, 300 µm s⁻¹) before trace element run
Sample Preparation Method.value: PMG thick sections polished; pre-ablation pass (2 J cm⁻², 20 Hz, 150 µm square, 300 µm s⁻¹) before trace element run

Pre-Ablation Surface Treatment.cell: Pre-ablation pass: 150 µm square, 2 J cm⁻², 20 Hz, 300 µm s⁻¹ scan before trace element spot run; removes surface contamination and re-deposited material
Pre-Ablation Surface Treatment.value: Pre-ablation pass: 150 µm square, 2 J cm⁻², 20 Hz, 300 µm s⁻¹ scan before trace element spot run; removes surface contamination and re-deposited material

Sampling Unit Selection Criteria.cell: Position relative to the metal-olivine rim — the line scans run "from the olivine rim in the direction of the olivine core" on large olivine crystals sited from the μXRF maps (p.4); the surface is pre-ablated before each analysis (p.3)
Sampling Unit Selection Criteria.value: Position relative to the metal-olivine rim

Pre-Analysis Imaging and Screening.cell: μXRF mapping of larger sections, on which the ablation is sited — Fe Kα intensity maps identify the mineral phases "based on the intensities of the Kα lines of the constituent major elements (Fe, Mg, Ni, Cr, S, Ca and P)", and the LA-ICP-MS areas correspond "to the locations indicated on the larger μXRF maps as black rectangles" (p.4). The instrument is a Bruker M4 Tornado with a Rh-anode source at 50 kV and 150 μA, focused to "a 25 μm spot (measured for Mo Kα)" (p.3)
Pre-Analysis Imaging and Screening.value: μXRF mapping of larger sections, on which the ablation is sited

Laser Manufacturer & Model.cell: Teledyne CETAC Technologies Analyte G2 (193 nm ArF excimer)
Laser Manufacturer & Model.value: Teledyne CETAC Technologies Analyte G2 (193 nm ArF excimer)

Interface Cone Configuration.cell: Al standard sample cone (1.1 mm aperture); Al H-type skimmer (0.8 mm aperture)
Interface Cone Configuration.value: Al standard sample cone (1.1 mm aperture); Al H-type skimmer (0.8 mm aperture)

Mass Resolution Setting.cell: Run 1: Medium resolution (M/ΔM = 4000) for major elements; Run 2: Low resolution (M/ΔM = 300) for trace elements
Mass Resolution Setting.value: Run 1: Medium resolution (M/ΔM = 4000) for major elements; Run 2: Low resolution (M/ΔM = 300) for trace elements

Detector Configuration.cell: Triple mode detection; Faraday used for major elements in run 1
Detector Configuration.value: Triple mode detection; Faraday used for major elements in run 1

Laser Wavelength and Type.cell: 193 nm ArF excimer; pulse duration ~5 ns
Laser Wavelength and Type.value: 193 nm ArF excimer; pulse duration ~5 ns

Laser Spot Geometry.cell: Run 1 (major): 30 µm circular; Run 2 (trace): 130 µm circular

Laser Spot Path / Ablation Mode.cell: Transect (line scan, run 1) + Spot (run 2 on same location after pre-ablation)

Laser Fluence (Energy Density).cell: Run 1 (major): 4.72 J cm⁻²; Run 2 (trace): 4.72 J cm⁻²
Laser Fluence (Energy Density).value: Run 1 (major): 4.72 J cm⁻²; Run 2 (trace): 4.72 J cm⁻²

Ablation Duration per Spot.cell: N/A (line scan run 1) / N/A (spot run 2 — duration set by 34 runs covering 400 µm + washout, not a fixed spot duration)

Transect Rate, Mapping Rate or Step Size.cell: 10 µm s⁻¹ (line scan run 1); spot mode (run 2)

Carrier Gas and Flow Rate.cell: He: MFC-1 0.19 l min⁻¹; MFC-2 0.22 l min⁻¹
Carrier Gas and Flow Rate.value: He: MFC-1 0.19 l min⁻¹; MFC-2 0.22 l min⁻¹

Make-up Gas and Flow Rate.cell: Ar make-up: 0.947 l min⁻¹ (run 1 and run 2); N₂ not added
Make-up Gas and Flow Rate.value: Ar make-up: 0.947 l min⁻¹ (run 1 and run 2); N₂ not added

Coolant (Plasma) Gas Flow Rate.cell: Cool: 15 l min⁻¹ Ar; Auxiliary: 0.90 l min⁻¹ (run 1 and run 2)
Coolant (Plasma) Gas Flow Rate.value: Cool: 15 l min⁻¹ Ar; Auxiliary: 0.90 l min⁻¹ (run 1 and run 2)

RF Power.cell: 1000 W (run 1 major elements + run 2 trace elements)
RF Power.value: 1000 W (run 1 major elements + run 2 trace elements)

ICP Tuning.cell: Same instrument as mapping; tuning optimized per run (different RF power and resolution settings per run)
ICP Tuning.value: Same instrument as mapping; tuning optimized per run (different RF power and resolution settings per run)

Oxide Production Method and Threshold.cell: N (normal plasma; no threshold stated for runs 1 and 2)

Analysis Sequence.cell: GRM block (3–5×) → unknowns → GRM block (3–5×); same structure for run 1 and run 2
Analysis Sequence.value: GRM block (3–5×) → unknowns → GRM block (3–5×); same structure for run 1 and run 2

Target Species.cell: Run 1 (major): ²⁵Mg, ²⁹Si, ³¹P, ⁴⁴Ca, ⁵³Cr, ⁵⁵Mn, ⁵⁷Fe (7 nuclides; medium resolution); Run 2 (trace): ⁷Li, ⁴⁵Sc, ⁵¹V, ⁵³Cr, ⁵⁹Co, ⁶⁰Ni, ⁶³Cu, ⁶⁶Zn, ⁸⁹Y, ⁹⁰Zr, ⁹³Nb, ¹³³Cs, ¹³⁷Ba, ¹³⁹La–¹⁷⁵Lu (all REE), ¹⁸⁰Hf, ¹⁸¹Ta, ¹⁸²W, ¹⁸⁵Re, ¹⁹³Ir, ¹⁹⁵Pt, ¹⁹⁷Au, ²³²Th, ²³⁸U (36 nuclides)

Monitored Masses.key: defines: monitored property per target species

Reported Variables and Units.cell: Major and trace element concentrations along the scan (µg/g), reported as profiles from olivine rim to core and as tabulated compositions (Table 1, p.5); Fa# "(fayalite, Fa # = FeO/(FeO + MgO) ∙ 100, atomic %)" is reported with them (p.5)

value.member: Major and trace element concentrations along the scan
reported as profiles from olivine rim to core and as tabulated compositions
Fa# "(fayalite, Fa # = FeO/(FeO + MgO) ∙ 100, atomic %)" is reported with them

Dwell Time per Mass.cell: Run 1 (major): 0.01 s per nuclide; samples per peak: 18; duty cycle: 2.069 s; Run 2 (trace): 0.01 s per nuclide; samples per peak: 7; duty cycle: 2.062 s

Background Count Time.cell: Run 1: 5 gas blank scans; 24 ablation scans; Run 2: 5 gas blank scans; 24 ablation scans
Background Count Time.value: Run 1: 5 gas blank scans; 24 ablation scans; Run 2: 5 gas blank scans; 24 ablation scans

Number of Replicates.cell: 3 replicate analyses per grain (3× run 1 + 3× run 2 on same location)
Number of Replicates.value: 3 replicate analyses per grain (3× run 1 + 3× run 2 on same location)

Internal Standard Approach.cell: Run 1 (major elements): sum-of-oxide normalization (MgO+FeO+SiO₂+P₂O₅=100 wt%; Liu et al. 2008); Run 2 (trace elements): single element IS from Run 1 (⁵³Cr concentration from major element run used as IS for trace element run)

value.value: sum-of-oxide normalization (MgO+FeO+SiO₂+P₂O₅=100 wt%; Liu et al. 2008)
single element IS from Run 1 (⁵³Cr concentration from major element run used as IS for trace element run)

Internal Standard Element.cell: Run 1: No single IS; oxide sum normalization; Run 2: ⁵³Cr (concentration from Run 1 major-element analysis on 30 µm spot used as IS for 130 µm spot trace element run)

value.value: ⁵³Cr (concentration from Run 1 major-element analysis on 30 µm spot used as IS for 130 µm spot trace element run)

Elemental Fractionation Correction.cell: Run 1: Oxide sum normalization corrects for ablation yield variation; external calibration using glass GRMs (NIST + USGS + MPI-DING); Run 2: Cr from run 1 as IS corrects for ablation yield; external calibration with expanded glass GRM set

value.value: Oxide sum normalization corrects for ablation yield variation
Cr from run 1 as IS corrects for ablation yield

Uncertainty Propagation Method.cell: Longerich et al. (1996) for LOD; uncertainty for concentrations not formally described

Signal Integration Interval Method.cell: Time-resolved signals inspected manually; unstable intervals at start and end discarded; Cr heterogeneities and inclusion signals (elevated P, Ca, Co, Ni) identified and excluded from integration
Signal Integration Interval Method.value: Time-resolved signals inspected manually; unstable intervals at start and end discarded; Cr heterogeneities and inclusion signals (elevated P, Ca, Co, Ni) identified and excluded from integration

Spike / Outlier Filtering Approach.cell: Manual inspection; analyses with elevated P, Ca, Co, Ni (phosphate or metal inclusions) excluded; Cr heterogeneities also flagged
Spike / Outlier Filtering Approach.value: Manual inspection; analyses with elevated P, Ca, Co, Ni (phosphate or metal inclusions) excluded; Cr heterogeneities also flagged

Blank / Background Correction Method.cell: Gas blank measured before each analysis (5 scans); average background value preceding each analysis subtracted from corresponding data
Blank / Background Correction Method.value: Gas blank measured before each analysis (5 scans); average background value preceding each analysis subtracted from corresponding data

Pulse/Analog Detector Nonlinearity Corre.cell: Applied: Run 1 medium resolution with Faraday for major elements; Run 2 low resolution; cross-calibration performed

value.value: Run 1 medium resolution with Faraday for major elements

Spectral Interference Corrections Applie.cell: Yes — cool plasma not applicable (normal plasma); argide corrections less critical; oxide interferences monitored; spectral interference list in Table C1

Interfering Species.cell: Same interference list as mapping (Table C1); argide-based interferences less critical without cool plasma

Interference Correction Method.cell: Argide corrections less critical (normal plasma); oxide-based interferences minimized by tuning; same interference list but without cool plasma mitigation

Memory Effect Mitigation.cell: Washout time: 11 s between runs (runs include 400 µm line + blank + washout)
Memory Effect Mitigation.value: Washout time: 11 s between runs (runs include 400 µm line + blank + washout)

Normalization / Standards-Based Correcti.cell: Run 1: 100% oxide sum normalization; Run 2: Cr IS from Run 1 applied; no further post-acquisition normalization

Analysis Inclusion and Rejection Criteri.cell: N — whole results are dropped, but on signal grounds: "where significant spikes in individual transient LA-ICP-MS signals were observed (e.g. Ca in CMS 04071 and Seymchan and Ni in Brahin and Seymchan), results were not included in Table 1" (p.6). By basis that belongs to Spike / Outlier Filtering Approach; no result-based selection rule is stated

Combination Method.cell: all: average of 3 replicate measurements — Table 1: 'The results shown are the average from 3 replicate measurements'

Primary Calibration Standard Name.cell: Same glass GRM set as mapping for Run 1; expanded set additionally includes MPI-DING KL2-G, ML3B-G, StHs6/80-G, T1-G, ATHO-G, BM90/21-G, GOR128-G, GOR132-G for Run 2 trace elements

Calibration Standard Measurement Frequen.cell: Same as mapping protocol; GRMs at start and end
Calibration Standard Measurement Frequen.value: Same as mapping protocol; GRMs at start and end

Secondary Reference Materials.cell: Same GRM set measured as unknowns for accuracy assessment

value.member: Same GRM set measured as unknowns for accuracy assessment

Detection Limit.cell: LODs reported in Table 1 for line scan + spot trace elements: Na=24, Nb=5 per Longerich et al. 1996; LOQ = 10SD criterion

members: LODs reported in Table 1 for line scan + spot trace elements
value.value: Na=24, Nb=5 per Longerich et al. 1996

Detection Limit Method.cell: Longerich et al. (1996); LOQ = 10SD criterion (same equation)

Limit of Quantification (LOQ) Method.cell: LOQ = 10SD of background counts (10σ criterion; Chernonozhkin et al. 2021)

Counting Statistics Error.key: sample > sampling unit x reported property

Internal (Within-Measurement) Analytical.key: sample > sampling unit x reported property

Within-Session Analytical Precision and.cell: LOD calculated per analysis (Na=24, Nb=5); precision not formally reported as separate metric

Analytical Accuracy and Assessment Metho.cell: Trace element accuracy verified against literature INAA and EPMA data; major elements verified by comparison with EMPA results from same section

Additional Notes.cell: Multi-run sequential design is the key methodological innovation: Run 1 (major elements, 30 µm, MR) provides Cr IS for Run 2 (trace elements, 130 µm, LR); pre-ablation pass removes surface contamination before Run 1
Additional Notes.value: Multi-run sequential design is the key methodological innovation: Run 1 (major elements, 30 µm, MR) provides Cr IS for Run 2 (trace elements, 130 µm, LR); pre-ablation pass removes surface contamination before Run 1
